summary: Verified root-cause fix in /app/frontend/src/lib/useBackGestureClose.js. The Log a Fault dialog on the FULL dashboard (FaultDialogs.js) NO LONGER closes when interacting with machine type select, serial number select (the historically-buggy step), existing-fault warning interaction, coverage banner render, or description typing. All required testids present and functional. No React `span cannot be a child of option` console error observed. Master Admin login + Organisations list load cleanly (regression sanity).

issues: 'Continue Anyway' button has Tailwind class `text-white` but computed color is rgb(24,24,27) — `text-white` is being overridden by a global/button base style. Text still legible on the teal (rgb(14,116,144)) bg, but contrast is not what the markup intends. Selector: [data-testid='continue-log-fault-btn']. Likely fix: add `!text-white` or check for a CSS rule scoped to button under .Dialog that's winning specificity.

Main dialog has no visible 'Cancel' button — only the X close icon and the Submit button. The existing-fault-warning has its own Cancel which closes the dialog, but once the warning is dismissed the user has no Cancel control. Likely an intentional decision but worth confirming with E1.

action_items: (Optional / Minor) Force `text-white` on the Continue Anyway button — currently being overridden by a higher-specificity rule and renders near-black text on teal background. Cosmetic only; not blocking.
(Optional) Decide whether the main dialog should have an explicit Cancel button in addition to the X icon.
critical_code_review_comments: Hook fix is correct and idiomatic: latest `onClose` held in a ref, effect deps narrowed to [open, key], cleanup uses `closedByPopstate` flag to avoid double-popping history. This is the right pattern for callbacks-in-effects.
useBackGestureClose is shared across at least 3 modals (FaultDialogs, LiteDialogs, AdminOrganizations). The single hook fix benefits all of them, which is the right place for the change.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary bug (Log a Fault closing on serial select) is RESOLVED on the FULL dashboard. Verified via Playwright on production preview URL with owner@isodemo.com. Existing-fault-warning shows '2 open faults already logged for Life Fitness Treadmill' listing both fault chips, Continue Anyway dismisses warning + keeps dialog open. Coverage banner ('Inactive coverage') renders without closing dialog. Description input works. Master Admin login works; the close-button selector inside the org drawer was not exercised (the drawer didn't open via row click in this run), so if a future report needs deeper coverage of AdminOrganizations, use the row's pencil/eye action button rather than the row body.
rca of the issue: RCA confirmed by main agent: callers pass an inline/useCallback onClose whose identity changes each render. The hook listed `onClose` in its effect deps, so multi-state-update onChange handlers (serial picker → setIssueForm + fetchCoverage + setExistingFaultWarning) caused effect-cleanup to run mid-interaction; cleanup called history.back() → popstate → the freshly-registered listener ran onClose() → dialog closed. Mitigation in /app/frontend/src/lib/useBackGestureClose.js: store onClose in a ref and depend only on [open, key]. Verified working via Playwright.
